changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.plum_setting ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, base_url TEXT NOT NULL, login TEXT NOT NULL, password TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO integration.plum_setting (id, base_url, login, password, created_date, last_modified_date) SELECT id, COALESCE(base_url, 'https://pay.myuzcard.uz/api'), login, password, created_date, last_modified_date FROM integration.integration_credential WHERE provider = 'PLUM' AND deleted = false ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
